annotation.title_clean: Delaware Code Title 11, Chapter 5, Subchapter VII: Specific Offenses Against Public Health, Order and Decency
annotation.title_en: Delaware Code Title 11, Chapter 5, Subchapter VII: Specific Offenses Against Public Health, Order and Decency
annotation.summary_en: Delaware criminal code chapter on offenses against public health, order and decency (disorderly conduct, hate crimes, stalking, animal cruelty, weapons, obscenity, gambling). Its only embodied-AI content is §1334, which criminalises unlawful operation of unmanned aircraft systems over events, critical infrastructure and first responders, and preempts local drone regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: §1334 bans operating drones over large events, critical infrastructure and first-responder incidents
§1334 drone misuse is an unclassified misdemeanor, escalating to class A if injury or damage results
§1334 exempts law enforcement, FAA-authorized commercial operators and university use
§1334 preempts county and municipal drone regulation
§1335 criminalises deepfake intimate imagery and covert surveillance
